item.title: HSBC: $4 Million Committed To Strengthen Job Pathways and Urban Environmental Resilience
item.description: HSBC Bank USA has allocated nearly $4 million in philanthropic funding to eight national and local nonprofit organizations focused on accelerating workforce development for low- and moderate-income adults and advancing clean air, clean water, and urban sustainability initiatives. item.title: Curi Bio: $10 Million Series B Closed To Scale Human-Relevant Preclinical Platforms
item.description: Curi Bio has secured a $10 million Series B round led by Seoul-based contract research organization DreamCIS, funding that will accelerate the expansion of the company’s integrated human-relevant preclinical discovery platform. The investment deepens a strategic partnership aimed at improving the predictiveness of early-stage drug development and reducing clinical trial failure rates. item.title: LizzyAI: $5 Million Seed Funding Raised To Transform AI-Driven Job Interviews
item.description: LizzyAI, a New York-based AI-native interviewing platform, has raised $5 million in seed funding led by NEA, with participation from Speedinvest and Zero Prime Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to expand engineering and go-to-market teams, deepen product integrations, and advance its adaptive interview engine. item.title: Fortify Expands National Footprint With Acquisition Of Rytech Restoration
item.description: Fortify Companies has acquired Rytech Restoration, expanding its national restoration platform to more than 30 states. The deal brings together Rytech’s network of 100+ franchise locations across 25 states with Fortify’s company-owned Insurcomm Restoration network, creating a unified platform serving over 100 markets nationwide. item.title: Citizens Adds New 401(k) Advisory Team As Private Wealth Expansion Accelerates
item.description: Citizens Financial Group has added its 10th new advisory team to its rapidly expanding Private Wealth business, introducing CF Retirement Solutions, a New York–based group focused on corporate employer-sponsored retirement plans. item.title: Mujin: $233 Million Closed To Scale Its Intelligent Robotics Platform
item.description: Mujin, the Tokyo- and Atlanta-based automation technology company, has closed $233 million in the first tranche of its Series D round to speed global deployment of MujinOS, its intelligent robotics operating system. The raise includes $133 million in equity led by NTT Group with co-lead Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), and participation from Mitsubishi HC Capital Realty and Salesforce Ventures, alongside $100 million in debt financing from leading Japanese financial institutions.
